CHICKPEA_RECOVERY_TOKEN.description: Generate once with `openssl rand -hex 32`, save it in your password manager, and paste the 64-character value here. Chickpea uses it only for initial setup and disaster recovery.

AUTH_DB.description: Chickpea's Better Auth identity and session database. Cloudflare creates and binds it automatically.

AUTH_GUARD.description: Sharded password-compute and throttle Durable Objects. Cloudflare creates them automatically.
